title: A Novel Imaging Protocol for Investigating Arabidopsis thaliana Siliques and Seeds Using X-rays
author: Brylie A. Ritchie
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

Petri dish (Fisher Scientific, catalog number: FB
Permanent ink markers Paper towels (Fisher Scientific, catalog number: 19-040-
X-ray source: Kevex PXS10-16W MicroFocus system Boss LS-1416 CO 2 laser cutter

steps.title: Gather materials and supplies
steps.instruction: Collect Arabidopsis thaliana ecotype Columbia (Col_0) plants at mid‑flowering, complete flowering, or seed‑harvest stage; fine‑precision medium‑tipped tweezers/forceps (Fisher Scientific, catalog 12‑000‑157); Petri dishes (Fisher Scientific, catalog FB0875712); permanent ink markers; paper towels (Fisher Scientific, catalog 19‑040‑898); tape (Fisher Scientific, catalog 15949); low‑density polyethylene plastic film for the platform; Kevex PXS10‑16W MicroFocus X‑ray source; Inspex 20i X‑ray machine; VetView console software.

steps.title: Set up low‑density platform
steps.instruction: Open the front door of the Inspex 20i X‑ray machine by pulling the metal latch at the centre‑right of cabinet J. Tape a low‑density polyethylene plastic film platform approximately 3.5 cm beneath the X‑ray source. Close the front door and confirm the latch clicks, indicating the interlock is engaged.

steps.title: Power on and warm up X‑ray system
steps.instruction: Press the power switch on control panel A, then turn ON panels B and C. Rotate the metal key on panel A counter‑clockwise to the ON position and press the green button on panel A. Verify that the red (X‑ray ON), yellow (interlock), and flashing green (main power) lights appear. Wait 10–15 minutes for the X‑ray tube to warm up until the green standby light is on, voltage and current read 0, and the X‑ray sign is OFF.

steps.title: Run dark calibration
steps.instruction: Double‑click the dark calibration tab on the desktop to start a dark calibration. Wait for the pop‑up window to disappear, indicating completion. Repeat the dark calibration once more.

steps.title: Prepare siliques on damp paper towel
steps.instruction: Dampen a paper towel with deionized water, place it in a large Petri dish, and squeeze out excess water so the towel is fully wet but not dripping. Using fine‑tipped tweezers, gently pluck one silique (with pedicle) at a time from the Arabidopsis plants and place it into a clear Petri dish. Transfer siliques onto the damp towel; keep each silique on the towel no longer than 1–2 minutes to avoid imbibition. Move one silique (or up to 5–6 side‑by‑side) into a small clean Petri dish and position a 1 cm scale bar next to the siliques.

steps.title: Load sample onto X‑ray platform
steps.instruction: Open the front door of cabinet J, place the small Petri dish containing the silique(s) and scale bar onto the taped low‑density plastic platform, and close the front door.

steps.title: Capture X‑ray image
steps.instruction: Open the VetView console program on the desktop. Click “new sample”, enter the sample ID and name, then click “capture”. Ensure the capture window is set to the whole sample and click capture again. Press the green ON button on control panel A, set the voltage dial to 40.0 V and the current dial to 0.09 A. Press the handheld X‑ray button H to start exposure. When the program displays “image acquiring”, click the red button on control panel A to turn the X‑ray beam OFF (the beam must not remain on longer than one minute after acquisition). Adjust the white marquee so the silique(s) and scale bar are inside; drag edges or corners as needed. Click “accept image” (or “reject image” to reacquire). If the image is unsatisfactory, reposition the small Petri dish and repeat from setting voltage onward.

steps.title: Process, crop, and save image
steps.instruction: After accepting the image, VetView returns to the home page. Select the sample name, click “open study”, and right‑click to adjust contrast if desired. Click the “save” tab to store the image file, then verify the file in the destination folder before proceeding.

steps.title: Remove sample and repeat imaging
steps.instruction: Open the front door of cabinet J and remove the small Petri dish with silique samples. Repeat steps “Prepare siliques on damp paper towel” through “Process, crop, and save image” for additional siliques as needed.

steps.title: Shut down X‑ray system
steps.instruction: Turn off the overhead lights inside cabinet J. Power down the system in reverse order of start‑up: switch OFF the desktop (panel C) then control panels B and A.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol is validated by providing data to support the claims. Please refer to Figure 4 , panel D & E, for details on the number of replicates and statistical tests.
